activity_summary: Still inside the morning, you ran the Muscovites. Nick and Arthur changed the favours and kept apart. The watchet was not on Nick, and the fifty shillings were still unpaid. Pope waited at the post for the Worthies. Garnish still had no total. You told Burbage to send the rhyme into the yard.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the space, refused the gown for today, and sent the rhyme outward.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Worked the wrong mask, and took the rhyme out of the hangings.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Held the glove, stood the shorter, and was not in the watchet.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Held the other favour, and did not stoop.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Waited at the post for the Worthies, shield in hand.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept the book, named no line-count, and left the column empty.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Mentioned in Muscovites, and the glove

facets.activity: Rehearsed the Muscovites with the favours in the boys' hands

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Fifty shillings is still the mercer's.

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The column beside Costard is still empty.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Let them laugh at the pedant before the messenger comes.
